responsibility: Declares the public entry points for GCC’s selective scheduler. It provides the top-level routine that runs selective scheduling and the helper used to decide whether debugging counters or configuration should suppress it, serving as the narrow external interface to the implementation in sel-sched.cc.
same_name_distinction: This header is the minimal external interface for selective scheduling, declaring the main run entry point and the debug-counter skip helper. The same-stem source gcc/sel-sched.cc contains the full scheduling algorithm and region-execution machinery.
